purpose: Challenge the remaining arbitrary-aset meaning boundary without a Meaning primitive: exact referent identity comes from the explicitly selected link occurrence and its finite link network; canonical recursive Anum remains an optional root-relative structural description only on its occurrence-tree domain; dictionary/theory/context relations provide higher interpretation without replacing the referent by a serialization or graph canonicalization.

recursiveAnumAsUniversalMeaning.reason: merged #210 already proves loss of explicit sharing identity and inability to directly encode general cycles

rootedGraphCanonicalizationAsSemanticIde.reason: isomorphic or bisimilar occurrence-distinct cycles must not collapse; Gate = #225 preserves exact local occurrence identity

semanticBoundary.referent: the exact link occurrence selected as current by explicit context/act evidence
semanticBoundary.network: the finite exact start/end closure reachable from that occurrence; cycles stop by revisiting the same occurrence, not by shape equality
semanticBoundary.rootAnchoring: a closure is root-anchored only by reaching exact distinguished R/O/C/L/U occurrences, never by merely matching their shapes
semanticBoundary.rootRelativeAnum: partial structural description available only when the accepted recursive occurrence-tree domain applies
semanticBoundary.higherContextualMeaning: explicit dictionary/theory/act relations over the same exact referent

requiredAssertions: the merged root-relative Anum contract remains explicit that recursive Anum is not general arbitrary-link meaning
a complete acyclic root-derived relation can use recursive Anum as a structural view without making the source spelling its identity
an exact self-cycle distinct from R remains a different occurrence even though it is shape-isomorphic to R
a start-self-closed cycle can be finitely root-anchored by an exact kernel occurrence without recursive unfolding
a mutual cycle with root-derived outgoing poles has a finite exact closure and does not require recursive Anum
an unanchored non-root self-cycle remains finite but has no root-relative structural anchor merely from its shape
explicit K selects one exact current occurrence without adding a host PointedGraph object to the ontology
two isomorphic cyclic pointed networks can have different exact referents and must not be collapsed by canonical graph labeling
the same exact referent can participate in two explicit dictionaries with different forms without changing its link structure
network traversal terminates on exact occurrence revisit and never uses shape equality as a cycle stop condition
no Meaning field, semantic tag, canonical graph id or L4 address is attached to Link

decisionCandidate.wording: For Foundation v2, meaning is not a total function from Link to a canonical payload. The minimal referential substrate is the exact link occurrence selected in an explicit act/context together with its finite link relations. Recursive Anum is a root-relative structural view on the occurrence-tree subset. Sharing/cycles remain native network structure. Dictionaries and theories add explicit contextual resolution relations over the same substrate.

notDecided: whether the word meaning should be used normatively for the whole relational substrate or reserved for contextual resolution
canonical source syntax for referring to arbitrary cyclic/shared occurrences
whether any future reference-capable Anum transport is needed
production L4 representation of occurrence identity
